description: This Java source file defines an interface ModifyFeatureLiveCommand which extends multiple interfaces related to live commands and feature modification within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides a method to access the Feature object to be modified and serves as a key part of the command handling for feature modifications.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureLiveCommand
classes.description: An interface representing a live command for modifying a feature, providing access to the feature to modify and integrating with the Ditto command framework.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Returns the Feature object that is to be modified by this command.
